summary: Order placement failures come from broker-gateway. Its rate_limit_remaining metric fell to 0.0 and the upstream broker API began returning 429 (retry-after 30s) at about 12:00:20. Callers order-router (weight 0.8) and orchestrator (0.3) then logged HTTP 503, and web-app logged order-router 503s. order-router err_rate reached 0.32 and broker-gateway err_rate 0.407. No deploy, config, migration or flag change touches broker-gateway. The only changes were wa-webhook and web-app deploys at 11:05 and 11:16. I found no evidence for the portfolio sync failures or the slow assistant: aa-sync, portfolio-svc, the portfolio-updates queue and llm-gateway all look normal in their summaries. Those two symptoms remain unexplained.

hypotheses.statement: broker-gateway exhausted its upstream broker API rate limit. The broker returned 429, broker-gateway returned 503, and order-router and orchestrator order calls failed.
hypotheses.label: medium

unresolved: Why orchestrator logged broker-gateway 503s from 11:55 while the first logged 429 is at 12:00:20 (the error log window was truncated at 50 of 309 matches).
What consumed the broker quota while broker-gateway rps stayed flat.
The cause of the portfolio sync failures; portfolio-svc, aa-sync and the portfolio-updates queue show no errors in their summaries, and portfolio-consumer was not checked.
The cause of the slow assistant replies; llm-gateway shows no obvious deviation in its summary, and time-series points were not examined.
Only summary metrics were retrieved, so exact onset times come from logs rather than metric points.

actions.text: Honor the broker's retry-after: add client-side throttling or backoff on broker-gateway calls, and queue or shed non-critical broker calls until rate_limit_remaining recovers.
actions.rationale: The broker is returning 429 and rate_limit_remaining is 0.0, so order calls are failing downstream.

actions.text: Check with the broker whether the quota can be raised, and find what consumed the quota while rps stayed flat (retry amplification, a batch job, or a quota change).
actions.rationale: Request volume was flat but the quota still ran out, and orchestrator 503s appear before the first logged 429.

actions.text: Investigate the portfolio sync failures and slow assistant replies separately. Pull time-series points for aa-sync, portfolio-consumer, llm-gateway and orchestrator, and look at logs for those services.
actions.rationale: The summaries for aa-sync, the portfolio-updates queue and llm-gateway look healthy, so the broker rate limit does not explain these symptoms.
